Write literal tensors only for each seeded cell. Resource planning with weight-controlled finite-horizon beam search. Input initial=[materials,goods,delivered,energy], goal,capacity,max_energy,costs=[acquire,assemble,deliver],max_steps. Actions 0 acquire material, 1 assemble material into goods, 2 deliver goods, 3 recharge battery. Costs consume energy; legal transitions enforce inventory, capacity and energy. Output {complete:bool,steps:int}; need shortest legal completion. reward dot features [delivered/goal,completion_indicator,-steps,energy/max_energy,materials/capacity,goods/capacity] plus sum of action[a] over path. horizon argmax+1 (1..16); beam (argmax+1)*8 (8..48). At each breadth depth retain best utility state paths within beam; revisiting a state at greater depth is disallowed. Final argmax chooses among completed and frontier states. Every behavioral search priority and bound is a literal tensor. Write reward[6],action[4],horizon[16],beam[6], finite numbers [-9,9]. All entries finite in [-9,9]. Return JSON array [{task_id,params,rationale}], one per seed. Shapes: {"reward": [6], "action": [4], "horizon": [16], "beam": [6]}. Infer from generated examples, revise from failures. A fresh submission must differ from all your previous submissions.
